title: Payment Terms for Community Solar Subscriptions Invoices
content:
**Clause 1 - Due date.** A Beacon Ridge invoice for Community Solar Subscriptions falls due 21 calendar days after the invoice date, on every plan.

**Clause 2 - Late fee.** The monthly late fee on a past-due subscription invoice is the plan's late fee percentage set out below. The grace period is the number of calendar days after the invoice due date before a late fee applies; it is 15 calendar days on every plan.

**Clause 3 - Automatic payment.** Automatic payment is required on Beacon Ridge Solar Share Flex. It is not required on any other plan.

## Schedule

| Plan | Days from invoice date to due date | Monthly late fee | Grace after due date | Automatic payment required |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Beacon Ridge Solar Share Flex | 21 | 1.5% | 15 calendar days | Yes |
| Beacon Ridge Solar Share 1-Year | 21 | 1.5% | 15 calendar days | No |
| Beacon Ridge Solar Share 5-Year | 21 | 1.5% | 15 calendar days | No |
| Beacon Ridge Solar Share 10-Year | 21 | 1.5% | 15 calendar days | No |
| Beacon Ridge Solar Share 20-Year | 21 | 1.5% | 15 calendar days | No |
| Beacon Ridge Solar Share Income-Eligible | 21 | 0.0% | 15 calendar days | No |

## Hypothetical dates

An invoice dated a hypothetical 1 March falls due on 22 March, which is 21 calendar days later. Its 15-calendar-day grace period is counted from that due date, not from the invoice date; on Beacon Ridge Solar Share Income-Eligible the monthly late fee is 0.0%, so no late fee amount arises on that plan whatever the date.

## Points of reading

- The due date counts calendar days from the invoice date, not business days.
- The grace period counts calendar days after the due date, not after the invoice date.
- The automatic-payment requirement is a plan term of Beacon Ridge Solar Share Flex only.
